comment: One entry per published face. `bundled` refs are <group>/<slug> where group is char|media|art (mapping to media/epaper/<id>, <id>_media, <id>_artwork); they ship in the .pbw and show before the phone has sent anything, so keep the set to one or two (~15KB each). `defaultSel` is a fresh install's selection, bundled or streamed. UUIDs are permanent once published — never change one.
